name: NoPorts
description: Open source (BSD-3-Clause) remote-access tooling from the Atsign Foundation, carrying OpenSSF Best Practices and Scorecard badges plus SLSA 3 compliance, not just vendor claims. The noports-iosxe integration runs as a Docker app-hosting container directly on Cisco Catalyst 9000/8000 switches, giving SSH, gNMI, NETCONF, and RESTCONF access with no inbound listening port on the management plane.
